name: Bathyal-Howe
description: An ocean of dust without banks. At the edge of sight, past dust seas stretching to the horizon, mirage-cities rise and collapse by noon, and the light turns brutal and white.
Thin air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.
The descent was survivable; what came after was not. Salvage rights to the escape pod debris field are contested by three claimants, two of them dead.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
